description: Source code for IP filtering API endpoints in Mattermost, including initialization, permission checks, retrieving, applying, and fetching the user's IP address.

methods.name: InitIPFiltering
methods.description: Initializes IP filtering routes and handlers.

methods.name: ensureIPFilteringInterface
methods.description: Checks if IP filtering interface is available based on license, feature flags, and configuration.

methods.name: getIPFilters
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve allowed IP filters.

methods.name: applyIPFilters
methods.description: Handles POST request to apply new IP filter ranges.

methods.name: myIP
methods.description: Returns the IP address of the current user.
